  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-26 and EDN-29} (2026-09-29): the window, the exclusion of \texttt{model} and the significance level, each set after a new measurement.},

  decision = {The drift job compares windows of 1,000 requests with 10,000 training listings, feature by feature at a Bonferroni-corrected level of 0.005, without the \texttt{model} feature.
The \texttt{ES} replay must be flagged with at least three drifted features besides \texttt{country\_\allowbreak{}code}.
Of 20 i.i.d. control windows, at most 1 may be flagged.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A seller-grouped control, as NFR-11 first said: measured, it is flagged as well, because unseen dealers differ as much as an unseen country.
\item Windows of 100 requests: three drifted features show up in at most 82\,\% of trials.
\item The usual level of 0.05: its false-alarm rate equals the 1 in 20 the requirement allows, and the control showed 0 to 2 flagged windows of 20, depending on the split.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} NFR-11 claimed properties of the data that nobody had measured.
With these settings the \texttt{ES} replay is flagged in every trial of three splits, and at most 0.6 of 20 control windows are.
\texttt{model} is left out because its 349 levels are too many for a chi-square test on a window of this size.},
